bio.text: Gretchen Rydin, a Democrat, has represented District 38 in the Colorado House of Representatives since January 2025.
According to Ballotpedia, she advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election.
Rydin earned a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University in 2006 and a graduate degree from Howard University in 2018, and has worked as a therapist and social worker.
